name: The bridge queues a short note into a chosen role's mailbox

scenarios.name: a note for a declared role is queued into that role's mailbox

steps.text: the caller sends a short note to a declared role
a note parcel is queued for that role at priority 00
the response confirms the note was queued

scenarios.name: a dormant role is a valid recipient

steps.text: the declared role the caller will name has no running session
the caller sends a short note to a declared role
a note parcel is queued for that role at priority 00

scenarios.name: the queued note is attributable to the operator

steps.text: the caller sends a short note to a declared role
the queued parcel is distinguishable from a note the coordinator wrote

scenarios.name: a message the handoff format cannot carry is refused

steps.text: the caller sends <message> to a declared role

examples.message: a message longer than the stated limit
a message containing a line break

examples.reason: that a note needs a message

scenarios.name: a role the swarm does not declare is refused

steps.text: the caller sends a short note to a role the swarm does not declare
the bridge refuses it stating that the role is not declared

scenarios.name: an unauthenticated caller cannot queue a note

steps.text: a caller with no valid token
the caller sends a short note to a declared role

background.text: a caller authenticated to the bridge
